change: makeQueryClient(config?) keeping the 2.x defaults (staleTime 30 s, gcTime 5 min, no retry on 4xx except 408/425/429; later reused as the channel's retry predicate). unwrap keeps the null-data throw and throws the NetworkError marker for a fetch TypeError. optimistic({key,scope?,targets:[{queryKey,apply}]}) returns {mutationKey, scope:{id}, onMutate (cancel, snapshot, setQueryData), onError (restore), onSettled (invalidate only when client.isMutating({mutationKey}) === 1)}. windowKey(window,{stepMs}) returns a quantised key plus a gated placeholder. Rule: none new (deprecated-fetch and raw refetchInterval clauses live in data-primitive). Skill: generated docs/{make-query-client,unwrap,optimistic,window-key}.md with the handlers-on-useMutation example. Tests: copy the 2.x tests (originals stay; imports adapted, assertions untouched), then spikes D and F as tests. A new public value symbol also lands, in this Issue, its raise in scripts/check-budgets/areas/surface.ts (the ceiling +1 and a `raises` row with from, to, consumer and repo) and its name in scripts/consumers.json (`<symbol>: <repo>:<path>`); make check refuses the symbol without them. retry predicate test: 4xx other than 408, 425, 429 never retries, 5xx retries up to the 2.x maximum
unwrap throws on null data and throws NetworkError for a fetch TypeError
windowKey: a rotating [from,to] inside one step keeps the previous data as placeholder; linewatch's ported queries tests pass
no module-level QueryClient exists (SSR test: two renders do not share a client)
